highlight: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and technical leadership in Frontend modernization: agnostic design systems, CASL/RBAC security, and agentic workflows (Platform Engineering).
achievements: Design and implementation of Spec-Driven Development (SDD): domain specs in src/domains/, layered agent knowledge (.claude/skills, .cursor/rules), and a typed ticket lifecycle with Notion sync via MCP.
Implementation and centralization of the ability-based authorization system using CASL in the backend, eliminating permission code duplication and securing the platform's multi-tenant infrastructure.
Architecture and migration of the frontend towards an agnostic Design Tokens and component tokens structure, drastically accelerating interface development and visual consistency.

Establishment of an AI-Driven Development workflow, designing conceptual modules (Gems) for architecture governance and leveraging agents (Claude) for automated design extraction, component generation, and cloud documentation (AWS/S3).
